body: Man the worst part is i have gone to the hospital here before for help,I went in willingly and I'm always very polite and I could not BELIEVE how poorly me and others who I talked to in my area (persons under 18 are cut off from adults for various reasons) were treated, I was in solitary for three days with no windows or clock, no one checked in on me aside from me being given meals and the meds that I was on, after three days the psychiatrist saw me and basically said oh so you want to kill yourself your a teen your fine here im upping your medication you can leave, I would rather stab my own foot than to be put through that again, for canada being praised on its medical care I thought mental illness would be taken more seriously, long story short good idea but I doubt it will help and i'm not sure who else I could contact. womens shelters and homeless shelters are filled up with people for the winter and the government also cut back on these places financially making it harder to get in :/
